artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2E - Portfolio Risk-Budget Decomposition

1_equity_market_directional_exposure.description: Risk-On regime maintains 130% directional equity market exposure (70% 1x single stocks + 60% 2x leveraged ETFs). Risk-Off drops to 30% directional exposure via XLE energy sleeve in E0, or 0% in D1/D2.

2_leveraged_etf_embedded_exposure.description: Overlay holds QLD (2x NDX) and SSO (2x SPX) at 15% nominal each. Total nominal 30% delivers 60% embedded equity notional. Zero broker cash borrowing or Reg T leverage is incurred; daily rebalancing leverage is fully internal to ETF wrappers.

3_market_beta_and_gross_economic_exposur.metric: Gross Economic Leverage vs Net Beta
3_market_beta_and_gross_economic_exposur.description: Gross economic exposure peaks at 130% during Risk-On and 100% in default E0 Risk-Off. D2 reduces gross economic exposure in Risk-Off to 50% via uninvested cash cushion.

4_single_security_concentration.description: Nominal rebalance target is 14% per stock across 5 stocks. Price drift between monthly rebalance intervals allows individual winners (e.g. NVDA, AAPL) to reach 26.92% peak concentration.

5_sector_and_tech_skew.description: Risk-On regime is virtually 100% exposed to Technology and Mega-Cap Growth factors (XLK/NDX). In Risk-Off, allocation shifts to Long Treasuries (40% TLT), Energy (30% XLE), and Cash/Short Treasury (30% SHY).

6_defensive_asset_correlation.description: TLT provided strong negative correlation during 2015-2021 equity drawdowns, but poses severe vulnerability in inflation-driven rate-hike selloffs (as occurred in 2022). XLE exhibits high positive correlation during broad demand-shock crashes (March 2020), failing as a defensive buffer.

7_risk_on_vs_risk_off_equity_exposure.description: The portfolio spent 82.0% of Tier 2 and 64.7% of Tier 1 in Risk-On mode. Risk-Off was triggered for 91 sessions in Tier 2 (COVID crash) and 444 sessions in Tier 1 (2015-2016 slowdown and Q4 2018 sell-off).

8_cash_exposure.simultaneous_order_cash_lockup: Resolved in Stage 2A-F via sell-first sequencing and priority queue
8_cash_exposure.description: Risk-On carries minimal unspent frictional cash (avg 2.45%). E0 allocates 30% to SHY cash-equivalent in Risk-Off. D2 increases true uninvested cash to 50% in Risk-Off, effectively dampening drawdown.

9_volatility_sensitivity.description: Portfolio exhibits convex volatility response to market dislocations. Because of 130% gross exposure, realized portfolio volatility jumps from 14.86% in normal bull regimes to 28.52% during market stress.

10_regime_switching_latency.description: 200-day SMA signal incurs an 18-session lag before exiting during rapid crashes, absorbing ~20% market drop before defensive trigger. Conversely, recovery re-entry is delayed by 24 sessions, missing initial sharp rebound.

11_rebalance_turnover.description: High turnover driven by monthly equity momentum rotation and overlay triggers. Tier 2 turns over 10.1x capital over 2 years (~506% annualized turnover).

12_transaction_cost_sensitivity.description: Modeled at 10 bps slippage per side. Cumulative costs subtract $5.37k in Tier 2 and $11.59k in Tier 1. Increasing slippage to 38.5 bps eliminates the overlay alpha.

13_drawdown_contribution.description: During the 31.75% Tier 2 drawdown, the 30% nominal overlay contributed 14.19 percentage points (44.69% of the drawdown), while the 70% equity basket contributed 15.11 percentage points (47.59%).

14_liquidity_and_gap_vulnerability.metric: Overnight Gap and Execution Timing Risk
14_liquidity_and_gap_vulnerability.description: The strategy executes once per day at market open. It has no intraday stop loss or dynamic hedge. Overnight gaps in 2x leveraged ETFs (QLD/SSO) are realized directly at open prices.

15_recovery_participation.candidate_d3_recovery_improvement: Reduced underwater duration by 5 sessions and lifted CAGR from 52.60% to 56.54%
15_recovery_participation.description: E0 remained in defensive assets until late May 2020, missing the initial 22.4% rebound from the March 23 trough. D3 partially mitigated this by relaxing re-entry criteria.

16_dependence_on_hindsight_selected_asse.description: Removing the top 3 tech performers (NVDA, TSLA, AAPL) cuts Tier 2 CAGR nearly in half (from 52.60% to 28.42%), demonstrating that Guardian Alpha relies heavily on secular bull runs of mega-cap US tech.

marginal_risk_contributions_euler.framework: Differentiable Covariance-Aware Marginal Volatility Contribution (Euler Decomposition)
marginal_risk_contributions_euler.key_insight: The 30% nominal overlay capital allocation generates 52.2% of the portfolio's total volatility risk. Nominal capital allocation severely understates economic risk exposure.

Frozen_E0.risk_profile: Baseline 130% gross exposure with 30% leveraged overlay and 30% SHY defensive cash

Candidate_D2.risk_profile: Reduces Tier 2 MaxDD by 10.55% via 50% explicit cash cushion in defensive mode; lower volatility drag

Candidate_D3.risk_profile: Matches D2 crash protection (21.20%) with higher recovery CAGR (56.54%), but worsens Tier 1 MaxDD to 20.48%

Candidate_C1.risk_profile: 0.22 volatility ceiling cuts overlay participation slightly, but causes drag in recovery bull market

Candidate_P4.risk_profile: 50/50 blend of equal and inverse-vol weights trims Tier 1 MaxDD to 16.59%, but suffers compounding return drag
